title: Exec staff campfire notes - March sync
content:
Goal: quick alignment on cascading risks for Dedicated launch, short decision list, and capture follow-ups to keep exec docket tidy. Tone: conversational, high signal, leave parking-lot for technical deep dives.

Logistics
- When: Thu 2026-03-14 09:30-10:30 PT (30m core + 30m optional drop-in)
- Room/Call: HQ - Boardroom B / Zoom link (see calendar invite)
- Attendees: Exec staff + product leads (invite list attached)

One-line objective for this sync
- Confirm go/no-go thresholds for Dedicated beta rollout in EU region and agree contingency plan for quantization regressions; surface any blockers that need exec escalation this week.

Quick metrics snapshot (bring 1 slide)
- Dedicated queue: 72% baseline utilization (target 60-80)
- Median p99 latency (prod-serving-runtime): 210ms (SLO 200ms) — trending +8% week-over-week
- Cost-per-request (hosted): $0.013/token equiv (model mix shift to 70B quantized)
- Eval regressions: 3 alerting prompt sets showing style drift after q4 quant patch

Agenda (30m focused)
1) 09:30 (5m) - Quick round: red/amber/green flags (one sentence per person)
2) 09:35 (10m) - Dedicated EU rollout readiness (ops + infra brief) -> decision: proceed as-is / delay 1 week / partial rollout to canary customers
3) 09:45 (7m) - Quantization regression triage (applied-ml + serving-runtime) -> assign rollback vs targeted patch
4) 09:52 (5m) - Commercial ask: pricing delta for early enterprise commits (finance) -> approve provisional $ discount band
5) 09:57 (3m) - Open escalation items & parking lot -> allocate owners and timelines

Prep notes for each topic
- Dedicated EU rollout readiness (Tom)
  - Current blockers: infra capacity reservation incomplete (region quota), PCI networking review in progress, canary customer onboarding doc needs final checklist.
  - Risk heatmap: quota shortfall -> delayed start; mitigations: short-term borrowed capacity from US feed (additional egress cost), or reduce initial concurrency per customer.
  - Ask to execs: permission to reassign two SRE cycles to finish network gating, and sign-off on the provisional customer communication (attached draft).

- Quantization regression triage (Ivana + Applied ML)
  - Root cause hypothesis: kernel reorder in kernel-7 path interacts poorly with recent attention cache invalidation; only shows on long-context re-rank prompts.
  - Impact: affects ~0.6% of production requests but disproportionately on high-value customers using rerank flows.
  - Options on table: rollback quant patch (fast, impacts cost improvements), targeted patch (likely 48-72h), or live mitigation with rerank fallback to CPU (higher latency, preserves quality).
  - Recommendation: short-circuit rollout for models using kernel-7 and schedule targeted patch; need sign-off for rollback if customer impact >1% by EOD Friday.

- Commercial pricing ask (Maya)
  - Proposal: limited-time pilot pricing for early Dedicated customers: 20% off list for 6 months in exchange for committed throughput and feedback obligations.
  - Finance caveat: margin impact acceptable if churn < 8% post-promo; legal requires contract amendment template.
  - Exec ask: provisional ok to proceed with outreach to 5 named prospects.

Open escalations (capture & owners)
- SRE quota escalation with cloud vendor (Tom) - unblock by 3/16 or escalate to CTO.
- Legal contract template for pilot pricing (Maya) - draft by 3/15 for review.
- Customer A reported regression (Ivana) - response to customer done, deeper RCA update due 3/13 EOD.
- Observability retention increase request (Data Platform) - finance + product to decide by next Thurs.

Immediate follow-ups post-meeting (rapid action list)
- Leah: circulate concise decision memo within 2 hours after sync (include precise roll-forward/rollback triggers).
- Tom: escalate region quota if vendor SLA not responsive by 3/14 18:00 PT; cc: CTO.
- Ivana: prepare 2 slide RCA + mitigation plan for Friday engineering all-hands.
- Maya: provide contract amendment skeleton to Legal and SalesOps by 3/15.
- All: label items in shared exec board with due dates and owners (I will do a pass on priorities).

Decision heuristics (to remind execs)
- Safety first: if a regression impacts >1% of revenue-generating flows, prefer rollback until patch verified.
- Cost vs quality: small latency increase acceptable for high-quality outputs for enterprise customers; preserve regressions-free baseline for canaries.
- Communication: customer-facing message must be coordinated with CS and Sales within 1 business day of decision.

Parking lot (topics for later deep-dive)
- Long-term kernel testing matrix and fuzzing plan (SRE + Applied ML deep-dive)
- Pricing elasticity experiments for Dedicated vs Hosted
- Iteration on rollout automation for cross-region capacity handoffs

Notes-to-self / facilitation prompts (use these to steer discussion concisely)
- Ask Tom: "If quota not available, what's the fastest incremental cost and time tradeoff?"
- Ask Ivana: "If we rollback, what is the estimated delta in unit cost and how quickly can we re-enable quant improvements?"
- If disagreement: propose 5-minute vote and record outcome + rationale in decision memo.

Quick capture template to use during the meeting (I will fill live)
- Item: (topic)
- Decision: (go / delay / partial)
- Owner: (name)
- Due: (yyyy-mm-dd)
- Next step: (short)

Closing note
- Keep the meeting tight—we want decisions + owners, not technical deep dives. Anything that requires >10m should move to the follow-up working session.

Unresolved questions to surface if time allows
- Do we want to adjust the default burst policy for Dedicated canaries to reduce overall risk? (ops cost tradeoff)
- Are there contractual constraints with top 3 early enterprise prospects that block our proposed pilot pricing? (Maya to flag)

End of notes.

-- Leah

[Attached drafts referenced above: canary-customer-commms-v1.md, dedicated-eu-checklist.xlsx, quant-regression-rca-draft.pdf]
